$schema_note: Flag registry for Empire Builder. Each entry pairs with a PNG in assets/flags/ (see docs/02-capital-and-flags.md and assets/flags/README.md). The game lists any flag that has BOTH a PNG on disk AND an entry here. These are EXAMPLE entries with placeholder art paths — replace/extend to match the real PNGs you provide. Balance rule: total power budget <= ~10 per flag (1% ~= 1 pt, a 'special' ~= 3-5 pts).

flags.name: The Ember Crown
flags.symbolism: A crown of flame over black stone — mastery of the volcano and the forge.
flags.flavor: Raised first by the smiths who dared the burning slopes; a promise that this people bends fire to its will.

flags.name: Banner of the Green Vale
flags.symbolism: A golden sheaf on green — abundance, harvest, and a people rooted to the land.
flags.flavor: Woven by the first farmers of the river meadows, blessed each spring at the planting.

flags.name: The Silver Wolf
flags.symbolism: A running wolf on grey — the hunt, the pack, loyalty, and the wild north.
flags.flavor: Carried by hunters who tamed the tundra's edge; the pack that never breaks.

flags.name: The Twin Rivers
flags.symbolism: Two blue rivers meeting on white — trade, unity, and the crossroads of nations.
flags.flavor: Flown over the first great market where two peoples met and chose commerce over war.

flags.name: The Azure Star
flags.symbolism: A lapis star on deep blue — knowledge, faith, and the light that guides the age.
flags.flavor: Stitched by the scholars of the first library; a star to steer a civilization by.

flags.name: The Ember Crown (Royal)
flags.symbolism: The Ember Crown wreathed in gold — the mature, imperial form of the founding banner.
flags.flavor: Unfurled when a settlement of smiths became a capital of kings.
